role: disclosure-safety gate for verbatim publication only. A ruling that a string is a complete, conventional public name says the STRING is safe to print; it does not validate what any occurrence refers to, and it does not establish entity boundaries in any context. Contextual reference is decided per occurrence in the adjudication ledger, never here.
rule: a containing span is published verbatim only if it appears here with publish_verbatim true; everything else is structurally generalised. Contiguous Han text is not evidence that a string is a complete name.

adjudication.method: AI-assisted repeated rulings, three per span, unanimity required for verbatim publication; external sources consulted
adjudication.sessions: separate model invocations without shared conversational state; independence between sessions is procedural, not demonstrated

disclosure: A ruling that withholds a string cannot itself print that string. Withheld rulings appear here only as opaque identifiers; the strings and their reasons live in the private rulings file whose hash is recorded above. Approved strings appear in full because they are published in the resolution table itself.
